title: Raman spectroscopy can recognize the KMT2A rearrangement as a distinct subtype of leukemia.
authors: Leszczenko, Patrycja; Nowakowska, Anna M; Jakubowska, Justyna; Pastorczak, Agata; Zabczynska, Marta; Mlynarski, Wojciech; Baranska, Malgorzata; Ostrowska, Kinga; Majzner, Katarzyna
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文用拉曼光谱与机器学习区分白血病亚型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML) are the two most common hematologic malignancies, challenging to treat and associated with high recurrence and mortality rates. This work aims to identify specific Raman biomarkers of ALL cells with the KMT2A gene rearrangement (KMT2A-r), representing a highly aggressive subtype of childhood leukemia with a poor prognosis. The proposed approach combines the sensitivity and specificity of Raman spectroscopy with machine learning and allows us to distinguish not only myelo- and lymphoblasts but also discriminate B-cell precursor (BCP) ALL with KMT2A-r from other blasts of BCP-ALL. We have found that KMT2A-r ALL cells fixed with 0.5% glutaraldehyde exhibit a unique spectroscopic profile that enables us to identify this subtype from other leukemias and normal cells. Therefore, a rapid and label-free method was developed to identify ALL blasts with KMT2A-r based on the ratio of the two Raman bands assigned to phenylalanine - 1040 and 1008 cm(-1). This is the first time that a particular group of leukemic cells has been identified in a label-free way. The identified biomarker can be used as a screening method in diagnostic laboratories or non-reference medical centers.
abstract_zh: 急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）和急性髓系白血病（AML）是两种最常见的血液系统恶性肿瘤，治疗难度大，且与高复发率和高死亡率相关。本研究旨在识别具有KMT2A基因重排（KMT2A-r）的ALL细胞的特异性拉曼生物标志物，该亚型代表儿童白血病中一种高度侵袭性且预后不良的类型。所提出的方法结合了拉曼光谱的灵敏度和特异性与机器学习，不仅能够区分髓系母细胞和淋巴母细胞，还能将具有KMT2A-r的B细胞前体（BCP）ALL与其他BCP-ALL母细胞区分开来。我们发现，用0.5%戊二醛固定的KMT2A-r ALL细胞表现出独特的光谱特征，使我们能够将该亚型与其他白血病及正常细胞区分开来。因此，开发了一种基于苯丙氨酸两个拉曼谱带（1040和1008 cm⁻¹）比值的快速、无标记方法，用于识别具有KMT2A-r的ALL母细胞。这是首次以无标记方式识别特定白血病细胞群体。所识别的生物标志物可作为诊断实验室或非参考医疗中心的筛查方法。
